_doc: The reader site's index: one square tile per chapter (by number), no words. Each shows a drawn face ("character", head only) or a prop drawing ("prop", optionally "rotate": degrees clockwise), on the chapter's typical ground: the most common panel ground that is not off-white or white, unless "ground" names one (data/grounds.json). Chapters with no panels yet show dimmed and are not links. Built by tools/build-site.mjs.
